title: Beltrami coefficient and angular distortion of discrete geometric mappings
summary: Over the past several decades, geometric mapping methods have been extensively developed and utilized for many practical problems in science and engineering. To assess the quality of geometric mappings, one common consideration is their conformality. In particular, it is well-known that conformal mappings preserve angles and hence the local geometry, which is beneficial in many applications.
